top_strength: Danah delivered both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) with full detail, terms, and resolution times, then closed the loop cleanly with a permission lead-in.
coaching_note: In step 2, probe deeper after the customer names specific concerns — you have the TV and the 100-year-old record player but you stopped after one follow-up; in step 5, after mentioning Monday-Thursday as Best Value Days, ask 'Would you be able to move on one of those days?' to unlock the savings; in step 7, when the customer hesitates, lead with the plain ask 'Would you like our help with your move?' before accepting the no.
